origin.name: OCLP's OpenCore config.plist for MacBookPro9,2, as pipeline/stages/build-efi.py generates it
origin.note: in the image's EFI partition, not in the System volume. Not declared here (no edit kind for it yet): the HaoExec.kext entry appended to Kernel.Add (plist.set cannot append), the early Tahoe kext entries (none on any recorded build), and removal of bootercfg and bootercfg-once from NVRAM.Add (OCLP's config has neither). The boot-args value is the one a build without a dev recipe writes: dev builds (IMAGE_DEV_BUILD=1) add hao_nx_stats=1 hao_bridge_stats=1 hao_diag_time=1 after hao_crash=1

edits.reason: the Darwin 27 kernel starts on Ivy Bridge: the kernel repairs in Kernel.Patch (on 26B131: early VM range initialization, ascending early kernel-map bounds, the bootstrap physical-page alias code and its registration call) and the IntelCommpage.kext Kernel.Add entry, computed by tools/kc-binder from the BootKC this image links
edits.evidence: apply.sh runs src/kc_bind.py on the image's BootKernelExtensions.kc, which refuses unless kc-binder's config.plist is byte-identical to the recorded kernel_repair_efi repairs src/repair_binding.py binds to that BootKC (or, when those refuse it, unless IntelCommpage's compiled addresses hold for it); src/repairs.py installs the result. tests/test_kc_bind.py (HAO_OPENCORE_BOOT_KC and the row variables) proves the bytes on the recorded 26B131 collections

edits.reason: OpenCore's DEBUG log goes to the file on the EFI partition only and nothing is printed on screen, so early-boot evidence can be collected from Recovery
the OpenCore file log also records informational lines, so it shows the result of each kernel patch

args.value: keepsyms=1 -lilubetaall ipc_control_port_options=0 -nokcmismatchpanic -pmap_pcid_disable amfi_get_out_of_my_way=1 hao_crash=1 ic_csr_internal=1 auxKCAtBoot=false

edits.reason: the Intel Mac boots Darwin 27 with its Lilu-based drivers loading, PCID off, hao's arm64-only programs allowed to start and hao's crash lines on the console, the Intel commpage reporting Apple-internal CSR so OCLP's on-disk Metal loads, a panic rebooting instead of waiting for a debugger, and kernelmanagerd loading the System kernel collection without first trying, and failing, to build an auxiliary collection
the next OpenCore boot deletes the firmware's boot logging overrides, so they cannot hide early-boot output
a normal boot shows only the Apple logo (owner 2026-11-13): no boot.efi or apfs.efi debug lines; the OpenCore archive is the RELEASE build unless the assembly asks for debug
